svg.title: Depthly — refined project workspace proposal
svg.desc: Three consistent desktop views: task list, Kanban board, and session history. Tasks organize the work. Sessions measure focused time. Example project with five tasks, three complete, seven sessions and three hours four minutes of focus. This is a design proposal.
svg.text: TASK LIST · scan the work and open a task for details
Check a task when the work is finished. Sessions record time separately.
Priority and status filters apply to both views
Open task to edit details and review focus history
Open task to edit details and review focus history
Tasks stay in this project. Set their working dates in the Planner.
KANBAN · organize tasks by their stage
Check a task when the work is finished. Sessions record time separately.
Priority and status filters apply to both views
Move a task here when you begin.
Drag tasks between columns to update their status.
SESSIONS · see the time behind the work
Sessions record focused work; they do not complete tasks automatically.
7 focus sessions recorded for this project
Open a session to review its details. “No task” means the session is linked only to this project.
